# desktop-lpbf-monitoring 0.1.0: every group, table and array (generated by lpbf_h5.py)

`{L}` is one group per layer, `L00001`, `L00002`, ...; the empty schema file holds it once as `_template`. Strings are variable-length UTF-8; arrays are chunked, gzip-4 with shuffle and a Fletcher-32 checksum.

## `/` (group)

one build

| attribute | type | units | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `schema` | str |  | 'desktop-lpbf-monitoring' |
| `schema_version` | str |  | semantic version of this layout |
| `build_id` | str |  | unique build id, also the file name |
| `created_utc` | str | ISO 8601 | file creation |
| `writer` | str |  | program and git commit that wrote the file |

## `/build` (group)

per-build metadata (monitoring.md §5.2)

| attribute | type | units | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `start_utc` | str | ISO 8601 | first layer's t0 |
| `end_utc` | str | ISO 8601 | last layer's scan end |
| `run_by` | str |  | person, or robot job id |
| `recipe` | str |  | recipe name |
| `recipe_sha256` | str |  | hash of the recipe file |
| `scan_file` | str |  | job / scan file name |
| `scan_file_sha256` | str |  | hash of the scan file |
| `alloy` | str |  | e.g. AlSi10Mg, 6061+Zr |
| `powder_lot` | str |  | lot id read from the reservoir's NFC tag (P-05) |
| `plate_id` | str |  | plate serial |
| `plate_material` | str |  |  |
| `module` | str |  | S25, M50 or L75 |
| `module_id` | str |  | module serial |
| `layer_um` | f8 | µm | nominal layer thickness |
| `n_layers` | i4 |  | layers built |
| `plate_setpoint_C` | f8 | °C | preheat set point |
| `focus_offset_mm` | f8 | mm | z offset of focus from the powder surface |
| `spot_um` | f8 | µm | 1/e² spot diameter at focus |
| `field_correction` | str |  | RTC6 correction file (.ct5) name |
| `field_correction_sha256` | str |  |  |
| `cover_slide_count` | i4 |  | builds on this cover slide |
| `start_O2_ppm` | f8 | ppm | at the first layer |
| `start_dewpoint_C` | f8 | °C | at the first layer |
| `power_check_W` | f8 | W | power-head reading before the build |
| `software_commit` | str |  | git commit of the control software |
| `rtc6_software` | str |  | RTC6 DLL / firmware versions |
| `monitoring_config` | str | JSON | instrument settings: gains, ranges, frame rates, filters |

## `/layers/{L}/rtc` (group)

RTC6 log: one row per 10 µs tick (NIST's XYPT, plus the output word)

|---|---|---|---|
| `period_us` | f8 | µs | 10 |
| `source` | str |  | set_trigger4 or StreamParser |
| `signals` | str |  | RTC6 signal names |

## `/layers/{L}/daq` (group)

digitizer stream for the layer, mapped to the RTC6 clock by fit_clock

| attribute | type | units | meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `fs_Hz` | f8 | Hz | nominal sample rate |
| `t0_index` | i8 |  | index of the first sample in the stream |
| `clock_a_us` | f8 | µs | t_rtc = a + b * (index / fs) * 1e6 |
| `clock_b` | f8 |  | rate ratio, 1 + drift |
| `clock_fit_rms_us` | f8 | µs |  |
| `clock_fit_edges` | i4 |  | gate edges used |
| `instrument` | str |  |  |

## `/layers/{L}/daq/pd1` (array)

|---|---|---|---|

| `amplitude_dBAE` | f4 | dBAE |  |
| `energy_V2s` | f4 | V² s |  |
| `rise_us` | f4 | µs |  |
| `duration_us` | f4 | µs |  |
| `counts` | i4 |  |  |
| `rms_V` | f4 | V |  |
| `skewness` | f4 |  |  |
| `kurtosis` | f4 |  |  |
| `snippet` | i4 |  | row in ae_snippets, -1 none |
| `label` | i1 |  | -1 unknown, 0 noise, 1 crack-like |
